visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Characters: A woman with short brown hair and a calm expression looks into a mirror, touching her cheek with her right hand. She is wearing a white pinstriped shirt over a white top. Setting: A brightly lit, minimalist indoor room with neutral walls. (2) Objects: A close-up shot of a lavender-colored skincare bottle labeled 'MARIA GALLAND 541'. Setting: Softly blurred indoor background. (3) Characters: The woman applies a drop of white, milky serum from the bottle onto her fingers and then massages it into her cheek using gentle circular motions. Objects: The serum's texture is shown in detail as it is spread on her skin. (4) Comparison: A split-screen visual displays a '2 weeks ago' vs 'After 2 weeks' comparison, showing her skin becoming more translucent and clear. (5) Objects: A golden tube of 'MARIA GALLAND 961' sunscreen is presented. Characters: The woman applies dots of the sunscreen to her face and spreads it evenly. (6) Characters: The woman poses with a radiant smile, resting her chin on her hand, looking directly at the camera with glowing skin. Objects: The two product bottles are shown together on a flat surface in the final shot.
